items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: And he said, did I want to come down, because he needed a drummer

ctx.x: But I was approached by Eddie Condon who said why aren't you at Nick's, and I said they wouldn't let me off on Saturday night for a couple hours so I could do my Hit Parade, which I was just starting to do. Record dates in New York, and everybody was recognizing me, because I'm on the Hit Parade.

And he said, did I want to come down, because he needed a drummer, and I think it was George Wettling's place that I took -- and I said yes, and he said you can take off on Saturdays and you send somebody that can play, because they were never satisfied, I don't know, a funny bunch of people they were -- they weren't satisfied with any subs I'd send, but anyway, he said to take off whenever I wanted, as long as you sent somebody that was capable to take your place. And that's how I went over to Eddie Condon's,…
